name: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundations Benchmark
description: The Center for Internet Security (CIS) Foundations Benchmark for Google Cloud Platform provides prescriptive guidance for securing GCP services. Covers IAM, Compute, Cloud SQL, GKE, Storage, and Logging.

controls.title: Ensure Compute instances do not have public IP addresses
controls.description: GCP Compute Engine instances should not have external (public) IPs. Use a Cloud NAT, load balancer, or Identity-Aware Proxy for inbound and outbound traffic.
controls.rationale: Directly-exposed compute instances bypass centralised security controls. Use private instances with controlled egress and managed ingress services.
controls.query: MATCH (i:GCPComputeInstance) WHERE i.public = true RETURN i.id AS resourceId, i.name AS resourceName, 'GCPComputeInstance' AS resourceType, coalesce(i.public_ip, 'public=true') AS evidence

remediation.summary: Remove the external IP from the compute instance.
steps: Network interfaces → set External IP to 'None'
Provision Cloud NAT if outbound internet access is required
For inbound access, use a Global External HTTPS Load Balancer or Identity-Aware Proxy

controls.title: Ensure Cloud SQL instances are not publicly accessible
controls.description: Cloud SQL instances should not accept connections from the public internet. Use Private IP, VPC peering, or the Cloud SQL Auth Proxy.
controls.rationale: Public Cloud SQL instances are brute-force and exfiltration targets. Private connectivity eliminates direct internet exposure and ensures all traffic flows through VPC controls.
controls.query: MATCH (i:GCPCloudSQL) WHERE i.public = true RETURN i.id AS resourceId, i.name AS resourceName, 'GCPCloudSQL' AS resourceType, i.region AS evidence

remediation.summary: Disable public IP on the Cloud SQL instance and use Private IP only.
steps: Open the Cloud SQL instance in Console
Enable 'Private IP' and associate with the VPC network
Update application connection strings to use the private IP or Cloud SQL Auth Proxy
Audit authorized networks to remove any 0.0.0.0/0 entries

controls.title: Ensure Cloud Storage buckets are not publicly accessible
controls.description: Cloud Storage buckets should not grant access to 'allUsers' or 'allAuthenticatedUsers' at the bucket or object level unless explicitly required.
controls.rationale: Public GCS buckets have been the source of major data breaches. Public access should be reserved for static website hosting on non-sensitive data, with explicit justification.
controls.query: MATCH (i:GCSBucket) WHERE i.public = true RETURN i.id AS resourceId, i.name AS resourceName, 'GCSBucket' AS resourceType, i.region AS evidence

remediation.summary: Remove public access from the bucket and enforce uniform access control.
steps: Open the bucket in Cloud Console
Permissions → remove any principals set to 'allUsers' or 'allAuthenticatedUsers'
Enable 'Uniform bucket-level access' to prevent fine-grained ACLs
Enable 'Public access prevention' at the bucket or organisation level
Audit object-level ACLs and set bucket to 'Fine-grained' only if required
